expression of my sympathy & distress at the shocking treatment of Dr Hadam, as I wish now to do.

I know how unkind it can be to suggest one can help when in fact one cannot. And I know no way of tackling the Home Office at such short notice - or indeed at any time & so could only suggest direct channels.

I hope to see Dr Hadam on Monday.

With very great regret & disgust at this uncivilised treatment.

Yours sincerely,

Janet Chauve
